newsitem.title: USA: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Nov prel. 98.9.
newsitem.headline: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Nov prel. 98.9.

text.p: The University of Michigan's preliminary index of consumer sentiment for November rose to 98.9 compared to 96.5 in the final October index, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component rose to 107.0 in the November preliminary report against the 106.6 reading in the final October.

The expectations index rose to 93.7 in the preliminary November data versus the 89.9 the final October, the sources added. The data are released only to paying subscribers. -- N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1660
